C0371.title: WordPress App Builder Plugin OTP Brute Force Vulnerability (CVE-2024-9302)
C0371.summary: Disclosed in October 2024, a critical vulnerability (CVE-2024-9302) exists in the WordPress App Builder plugin version 5.3.7 and earlier. The password reset function's OTP verification mechanism lacks brute-force protection, allowing unauthenticated attackers to enumerate OTP codes and take over any user account, including administrators. The CVSS score is 9.8.
